title: Siman 390
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: אֲנִי כּוֹתֵב אֵיזֶה דָּבָר וְשׂוֹרֵף. אֲנִי שׁוֹלֵחַ הַדָּבָר
segments.en: (52.) In Likutay Tinyana, Torah 4 — regarding what is explained there about the cure for the wound — which on the surface has no explanation for those words and what their relevance is in that teaching. Said the transcriber: I heard from our people that before this Shavuos on which the aforementioned teaching was said — an important person of our people in Ladizhin took ill — meaning he had a very severe wound, G-d save us, and was very ill.
